items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Geechee Smith turned out to be a very nice musician and he was one of those high note trumpet players.

ctx.x: And later on when Godley left, Henry Smith, who was the father of Geechee Smith, and his home was in Tulsa and Trent broke up one of those times and so Henry Smith came back to Tulsa and so when he came back to Tulsa he would always--I always seemed to be doing more than any others down there and so I got Henry Smith in the band, and he was the greatest, a very fine drummer, and then we all predicted then his son, he began to play, we predicted he was going to turn out good, and he sure did. Geechee Smith turned…
Who was this white band that he found there--who was that guy Cherokee?
